thread.title: 8 Biggest Price Target Changes For Tuesday

author: Lisa Levin
title: 8 Biggest Price Target Changes For Tuesday
text: Lisa Levin , Benzinga Staff Writer {{following ? "Following" : "Follow"}} January 23, 2018 9:55am Comments Share: Leerink Swann raised Juno Therapeutics Inc (NASDAQ: JUNO ) price target from $56 to $87. Juno Therapeutics shares closed at $86.00 on Monday. Morgan Stanley cut the price target for GoPro Inc (NASDAQ: GPRO ) from $9.5 to $5. GoPro shares closed at $6.30 on Monday. Susquehanna increased the price target for Dicks Sporting Goods Inc (NYSE: DKS ) from $25 to $41. Dicks shares closed at $34.62 on Monday. Morgan Stanley boosted Apple Inc. (NASDAQ: AAPL ) price target from $200 to $205. Apple shares closed at $177.00 on Monday. SunTrust Robinson Humphrey raised the price target on Crispr Therapeutics AG (NASDAQ: CRSP ) from $16 to $45. Crispr Therapeutics shares closed at $33.75 on Monday. Loop Capital boosted the price target for Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ) from $1,300 to $1,500. Amazon.com shares closed at $1,327.31 on Monday. KeyBanc Capital Markets raised Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ: NFLX ) price target from $270 to $300. Netflix shares closed at $227.58 on Monday. Morgan Stanley increased the price target on NetApp Inc. (NASDAQ: NTAP ) from $41 to $64. NetApp shares closed at $63.52 on Monday. © 2018 Benzinga.com. Benzinga does not provide investment advice.
